verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail is a SaaS service with a public developer API, so agent-oriented docs are a fair thing to ask about. The evidence shows no such docs: /llms.txt returns 404, the developers page has no markdown version, and every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returns 404. The docs only mention an API and a Zapier integration in general terms, with no machine-readable or agent-oriented documentation.
